title: Image To SVG Converter
description: Trace a URage image artifact to an SVG using the bundled ImageTracer implementation.

imageId.description: ID of the imported or generated URage image.

imageFileName.description: File name returned with the source image.

smoothing.description: ImageTracer line and quadratic threshold. Defaults to 1.

colors.description: Maximum trace palette colors. Defaults to 16.
